'''Fotbal Club Municipal Ungheni''', commonly known as '''FCM Ungheni''',  is a [[Moldova]]n [[football (soccer)|football]] club based in [[Ungheni, Moldova]]. They were founded in 2000 and they play in [[Moldovan Liga 1|Liga 1]], the second division in [[Moldovan football]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=FC Ungheni - Soccer - Team Profile - Results, fixtures, squad, statistics - Global Sports Archive |url=https://globalsportsarchive.com/team/soccer/fc-ungheni/20652/?utm_source=chatgpt.com |access-date=2025-08-19 |website=globalsportsarchive.com}}</ref>"}}
